identity.name: Spine
identity.source_note: Encoded from the official Spine Instructions for Authors served via the Ovid Editorial Manager portal (edmgr.ovid.com/spine/accounts/ifauth.htm). The journals.lww.com/spinejournal Instructions page returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch (bot protection); the Ovid Editorial Manager IFA is the same authoritative instructions and returned a clean ~41k-char SSR HTML page to curl.

encoding_notes: Source is the Ovid Editorial Manager Instructions for Authors (edmgr.ovid.com/spine/accounts/ifauth.htm); the journals.lww.com/spinejournal Instructions page and the Ovid landing pages both 403 to curl/WebFetch, so the Editorial Manager IFA page was used as the authoritative live guide.

layout.font is NOT specified by the guide (it fixes only paper size, 1-inch margins, and double spacing). Times New Roman 12 is recorded as a conventional manuscript default because the schema makes layout.font non-nullable; treat as engine-flag, not a journal rule.
layout.headings = null: the guide names the four main headings (Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion) but does not specify their case/bold/italic formatting.
line_numbers set to 'continuous' from 'manuscript text with line and page numbers'; the guide requires line numbers but does not state continuous vs per-page.

references.style = 'ama' because the guide states 'pattern manuscript style after the American Medical Association Manual of Style (10th edition)'. in_text = 'superscript' is derived from that named AMA style (the guide gives a numbered reference-list example and says cite in order of appearance, but shows no in-text marker example); in_text_punctuation left null (not stated).
references.include_doi = false: the guide's sample references carry no DOI and DOI is mentioned only in the preprint-update context, not as a required reference element.
references.et_al_threshold = 3: 'if there are more than three authors, name only the first three authors and then use et al.' journal_abbrev = 'nlm' (Index Medicus abbreviations).

Word limits: original/regular submissions 2700 words (excluding abstract and references); case reports 750 words and must carry a structured abstract (published online only); letters to the editor 200 words with <=3 references. Research letters are limited to <=5 reference citations (not separately encodable in the ARTICLE_TYPES enum).

Structured abstract subheads are journal-specific (Study Design, Objective, Summary of Background Data, Methods, Results, Conclusions), max 300 words; keywords count is 10-15 ('list ten to fifteen key words'). Spine also requires 3-5 'key points' (encoded as misc.highlights_required = true) and a 50-word mini-abstract (encoded as a section, no dedicated schema field).

tables.placement = 'grouped_end' from 'do not embed tables within the body of the manuscript; key each on a separate sheet'; max five tables. tables.numbering = 'arabic' from 'number tables consecutively' (arabic not stated verbatim; AMA convention).

figures.formats limited to schema-representable types (tif/tiff/eps/pdf); the guide also accepts MS Office ppt/doc artwork, which the enum cannot represent. figures.min_dpi = 300 is the halftone/photograph minimum; line art must be vector or >=1200 dpi (not separately encodable). callout_style left null (the guide uses 'Fig' in its own examples but does not mandate a callout style).

blinding: separate_title_page = true (Title page is a distinct required submission component carrying authors/affiliations/COI/funding). double_blind = false and scrub_body_identifiers = false: the guide requires PATIENT/institution de-identification of figures ('blinded for peer review') and patient anonymity/informed consent, but does not mandate author-masked (double-blind) review or scrubbing author identifiers from the body.

misc.cover_letter_required = false: the guide references 'the cover letter of the submission' only for preprint disclosure and does not state a universal cover-letter requirement. orcid_required = false: ORCID is not mentioned in the guide.

article_types limited to those the fetched IFA specifies structure/limits for (original_research, case_report, letter). Spine also publishes reviews and special-section content, but this IFA page does not enumerate their structure or word limits, so they are not encoded.
identity.issn (0362-2436) is the Spine print ISSN from the official LWW catalog, not from the guide text itself.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
